_comment: Command `<COM>_Interrupt` kojo: the act's participants react when someone walks in on the act (MapUtility.CheckReverseInterrupt; listener = the newcomer). Accepted acts only; a refuse branch can never pass here.
label: 被撞见口上
_comment_speakers: The speaker is always its EP's doer or receiver (Job.GetActorEPs), the listener the newcomer: a doer + receiver split (alone: a doer branch) covers every speaker, so no generic fallback is needed after it.
_comment_required: fallback: the role branch must be a fallback for that role with these fields. No awareness gate before the lookup (MapUtility.CheckReverseInterrupt): a receiver that can't act (asleep, unconscious …) fails a default receiver branch (requireSelfAction true) and would fall through to the generic fallback, written for an awake speaker. Its unaware lines go in speaker-status children of the receiver branch.
